defect_summary: Pull request #71 was stored as squash cc43f3e (one parent) and could not be tagged.
unsuitable_process: The hub repo allows squash onto main for a release/v* ship PR. ADR 0044 requires a merge commit; nlc_release_context detects a one-parent object after it exists. No ruleset makes squash illegal on that path.
climb_steps: cc43f3e has one parent and is not taggable.
Containment reports not a merge commit after the object lands.
ADR 0044 tag-on-merge-commit is policy without a store-time lock.

repo_touch.belief: ADR 0025 — defects name unsuitable process, not agents
